name: streamflow
description: Automated IPTV stream management for Dispatcharr. Match streams with regex or TVG-ID, measure stream quality, manage provider capacity, schedule checks and monitor playback. Requires an existing Dispatcharr instance reachable from the container. Configure the connection in StreamFlow's setup wizard after installation.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent database, settings, regex rules and playback history. Use a separate directory for each StreamFlow installation.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the StreamFlow web interface. Change this if port 5000 is already in use.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID used to run StreamFlow. The default is Unraid's nobody user.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID used to run StreamFlow. The default is Unraid's users group.
